body.summary: changedFiles reads the Story's commits first and adds only uncommitted edits of the Story's own files, reporting the rest as excludedUncommitted; a storyKey without a base is refused and collectBuildChangeLog forwards the storyKey. The two edits outside changed-files.ts are tests this change broke, fixed as the implement prompt requires ("finish ... the callers and tests it breaks"); no production code outside the task changed. build-step.test.ts: three validate-writer tests left the Story's work uncommitted, which the new rule no longer counts, so they now commit it before validate (a beforeValidate hook on the shared helper), the dirty-tree test asserts the new rule, and one md assertion no longer pins line order. subject-attribution.test.ts: the dirty-tree half now expects the Story's trailered files instead of the uncommitted README.md; the working-tree step-down half is left for t5.
